text:
ticket-bot: New ticket #10234 opened by customer (Acme Corp) — reported 401 invalid_api_key on /v1/chat. Customer pasted something into the API key field; logs attached.

Mia (Support): Reproduced locally using the blob they pasted. Looks like they copied an SSH public key into the API key box. Example pasted value:

```\nssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQC3u...snip... user@laptop\n```

Server response:

```\nHTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\n{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"API key malformed or not found\"}\n```

Mia (Support): Customer says they clicked the copy icon next to a key in their devbox and pasted it into our dashboard key field. They expected it to work — thinks it's the same secret. :facepalm:

Omar (Eng): Ah — that's a common UX trap. SSH pubkeys start with "ssh-" and are whitespace-separated; our validator rejects them but the error is generic. Can we detect the ssh- prefix and return a clearer message? E.g. "Looks like an SSH public key — please provide your Redwood API key (no spaces, does not start with ssh-)".

Mia (Support): I can post that to the customer as a quick fix. Proposed reply:

"Thanks — it looks like you pasted an SSH public key into the API key field. Please copy the API key from the Redwood dashboard > API keys (it will not start with 'ssh-' and contains no spaces). Once you replace it the 401 should clear. If you want, paste the value (obscured) and I'll confirm formatting.)"

Lina (Docs): I'll add an FAQ snippet and a short note on the dashboard key copy tooltip: "Don't paste SSH keys or other unrelated credentials." Also add a short example showing an SSH public key vs a valid API key.

Omar (Eng): I'll file INF-451 to: 1) return a specialized 401 message when payload starts with "ssh-"; 2) add a small dashboard client check to warn on paste/copy; 3) include a quick lint on server to strip obvious whitespace/newlines and reject non-key prefixes early. ETA: next sprint.

Mia (Support): Thanks. I'll update ticket #10234 with the customer message and the suggested steps, ask them to try a new API key copy, and mark as awaiting-customer. Leaving suggested reply in ticket comment now.

ticket-bot: Internal issue INF-451 created and linked to ticket #10234. Assigning to Omar.

Omar (Eng): quick follow-up — we should also log the invalid-type reason in our auth audit (reason=prefix_ssh) so support can triage without repro. Short PR incoming.

Mia (Support): Perfect. Closing internal loop for now — will update thread when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
